title: Apache superset: aiohttp is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python (CVE-2024-30251)
description: CVE-2024-30251 is a high-severity security vulnerability affecting the apache-superset package, related to the aiohttp asynchronous HTTP client/server framework used in Python. The flaw impacts versions prior to 2021.38.2-r0 and 2021.36.5-r0. It does not affect confidentiality or integrity but causes a high impact on availability. A patch is available in versions 2021.38.2-r0 and 2021.36.5-r0.
